newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian boxing champion arrested in drugs case.
newsitem.headline: Romanian boxing champion arrested in drugs case.

text.p: Romanian boxing Olympic silver medallist Daniel Dumitrescu has been arrested for alleged cocaine trafficking, Bucharest police said on Monday.
A spokesman said Dumitrescu had been arrested with his two brothers and two other men in the western city of Timisoara.
"They were arrested on Friday after they had brought more than 2.4 kg (five pounds) of cocaine into the country from Turkey," the spokesman said by telephone.
The Media Fax news agency said the group's intention had originally been to transport the cocaine to Italy but the men then decided to sell it to students in Romania.

It was not clear whether prosecutors had formally charged Dumitrescu and his comrades. Trafficking carries penalties of up to seven years in prison and journalists close to the investigation estimated the value of the cocaine at $42,000.
Dumitrescu, 32, was a Romanian boxing champion for 15 years in both junior and senior competitions, taking part in the 57 kg category. He won a silver medal at the 1988 Seoul Olympics.
